item.text:
The cold climate air-source heat pump is **Upgrade 4 (04)** in ResStock 2025 Release 1, as listed on the [ResStock Upgrade Measures page](https://natlabrockies.github.io/ResStock.github.io/docs/upgrade_measures.html).

It is documented in **ResStock Measure Documentation: Cold Climate Air-Source Heat Pump**, by Philip White and Andrew Parker, report **NLR/TP-5500-96413**, May 2026. [Read the report](https://docs.nlr.gov/docs/fy26osti/96413.pdf).
